name: Bitcoin Multi-Timeframe SMA Monitor
description: Monitor Bitcoin price trends across daily and 30-minute timeframes using simple moving averages. Daily view shows 20, 50, and 200-day SMAs for long-term trend identification. Intraday 30-minute view shows 240-period SMA (5-day equivalent for 24/7 crypto markets) for short-term trend analysis.
source:
# Daily data source
src_daily = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src_daily.c

# Daily SMAs
sma_20 = ma(period=20, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_50 = ma(period=50, type=MAType.sma)(close)
sma_200 = ma(period=200, type=MAType.sma)(close)

# 30-minute data source
src_30min = market_data_source(timeframe=30Min)()
close_30min = src_30min.c

# 30-minute SMA (240 periods = 5 days for 24/7 crypto)
sma_240 = ma(period=240, type=MAType.sma)(close_30min)

# Daily chart
timeseries_lines(
    title="Bitcoin Daily Price with SMAs",
    category="Daily Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 20", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 50", color=Color.Orange),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 200", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(close, sma_20, sma_50, sma_200)

# 30-minute chart
timeseries_lines(
    title="Bitcoin 30-Min Price with 5-Day SMA",
    category="Intraday Analysis",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Close 30Min", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="SMA 240", color=Color.Purple)
    ])
)(close_30min, sma_240)
